description: Profile a slow API endpoint and document the bottleneck. TASK STEPS: (1) Open the integrated terminal in VSCode using Ctrl+`. (2) Run the profiling command: 'python tests/test_performance.py' from the workspace root directory /home/ga/workspace. This will generate a file called profile_results.txt in the workspace. (3) Open and analyze profile_results.txt to identify which function consumes the most execution time. Look for the function with the highest cumulative time - it should be 'enrich_customer_data' in the file 'external_api.py'. (4) Create documentation in the file /home/ga/workspace/PERFORMANCE.md with the following sections: '# Performance Analysis: /api/process-orders', '## Problem' (describe the issue), '## Investigation Method' (profiling approach used), '## Bottleneck Identified' with subsections for 'File:', 'Function:', 'Time Consumed:', '## Root Cause' (why it's slow), '## Recommended Fix' (suggestion), and '## Profiling Command' (the command used). (5) In the documentation, identify that the bottleneck is the 'enrich_customer_data' function in 'src/utils/external_api.py'. (6) Open the file /home/ga/workspace/src/utils/external_api.py and add a TODO comment above or near the line containing 'time.sleep(2.5)'. The comment should mention caching or the performance issue and reference PERFORMANCE.md. Example: '# TODO: CRITICAL - Add caching layer, taking 2.5s per request (see PERFORMANCE.md)'. (7) Save all files.
